history.body: Hi, saw your ad. We may need a bit more space for the family, but still not sure yet.

I understand—needing more room for the family is a good reason to explore, even if you’re not sure yet. This home has 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms across 900 sq. ft., which could give everyone more room to spread out. Is the main need an extra bedroom, or more breathing room in the shared areas?
Mostly just more breathing room. Our rental feels a bit cramped, but we’re still thinking it through.

That makes sense—if the shared areas feel cramped, the 900 sq. ft. layout’s open-plan living, dining and kitchen, with no long internal corridor, may make the space feel more usable for family time. A viewing would let you judge the scale against your rental for yourselves. If a look would help, I can have our team arrange one; no pressure while you’re weighing up the move.
